exposure: surgical treatment of cesarean scar diverticulum (CSD)
cohort: 106 pregnant women with cesarean scar diverticulum (CSD)
finding: Surgical intervention for cesarean scar diverticulum (CSD) reduced the incidence of cesarean scar pregnancy and increased the number of live deliveries, but did not reduce the risks of placenta previa, placenta accreta, uterine dehiscence, or uterine rupture.
mod_finding: Women who underwent surgery for Cesarean scar diverticulum had a lower incidence of Cesarean scar pregnancy and a higher incidence of live delivery in a subsequent pregnancy.
